name: toasts
title: Toasts
description: Stacked toasts. A new one rises in front, older ones step back, a fourth pushes the oldest out. useToasts() gives you toast(text, tone).
docs:
Toasts needs these transitions.dev snippets in the app:

  npx transitions-dev add banner-stacking

Load obvious's primitives and a theme first, then the transitions.dev CSS, then obvious/css/transitions-bridge.css, so the colours come from the theme.
